# registry_oidc_config (Data Source)

Reads the backend OIDC configuration (read-only). The client secret is never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_oidc_config" "current" {}

output "oidc_issuer" {
  value = data.registry_oidc_config.current.issuer_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `default_role` (String) Default role assigned when no group mapping matches.
- `group_claim_name` (String) JWT claim name used to extract group membership.
- `id` (String) UUID of the OIDC configuration.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether this OIDC configuration is active.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `name` (String) Display name of the OIDC configuration.
- `provider_type` (String) OIDC provider type (e.g. generic, okta, azure-ad).
- `redirect_url` (String) OAuth2 redirect URL.
- `scopes` (List of String) Requested OIDC scopes.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
